answer_1.quote: Aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) aims to extract aspects mentioned in reviews and identify their corresponding sentiment polarities... we apply it to the Machine Translation task.
answer_1.outputs: Generated aspect-sentiment pairs, triplets, quads, and translations

answer_2.quote: Evaluation metrics are precision (P), recall (R), and F1 based on the exact match of the aspect and its sentiment polarity... we directly calculate acceptable scores based on the BLEU algorithm.

answer_3.quote: we ask the methods (based on LLaMA3-8B) to identify the acceptable one.
